message.content: I'm dominant and my reds are now a wall. Let me activate the green monopoly cheaply by unmortgaging both green properties—doubles the rent immediately and adds coverage against the nearly-bankrupt opponents.
message.reasoning:
I'm sitting on $1065 with a dominant position—my opponents are nearly broke. I've already built up my reds this turn, so now I'm considering unmortgaging North Carolina and Pennsylvania to complete my green set and start building there, plus potentially unmortgaging Short Line to maximize my cash efficiency while I'm ahead.

The math is tight though: unmortgaging those two properties costs around $286, then building three houses on each green property would run $1800 total—way more than I can afford right now. Since my reds already generate enough rent to bankrupt my opponents instantly, I don't need to overextend. The smarter play is just unmortgaging the greens to activate the monopoly bonus (which doubles rent even without houses) and gives me better board coverage, without actually building on them yet.
